scope: Read-only reconciliation of publicly reachable CrownThrive-owned or CrownThrive-linked surfaces. No authenticated provider, payment, entitlement, incident-management, DNS, hosting, or website mutation was performed.
methods: rendered DOM and destination inspection for dynamic pages
public link and copy comparison across first-party surfaces
evidence_boundary: A reachable page, marketing statement, link, plan route, status widget, or documentation source is evidence only of what the public surface represented at the observation time. It does not independently prove the underlying runtime, entitlement, rights, legal, provider, production, or release state.

public_surface_gate.reason: Material public contradictions, a suspended primary CHLOM destination, a partial-outage status representation without published incident detail, sparse support coverage, and unverified commerce-to-entitlement mappings remain unresolved.
public_surface_gate.source_change_effect: This repository candidate may record and repair documentation source. It does not close the HOLD or prove that any public provider deployment changed.

evidence.claim: The homepage displayed the counters 60++ platforms, 125k+ members, 25++ countries, and 20++ years.

The homepage visibly labeled ten portfolio cards as archived: Melanated Stock, SocialAIly, The Artful Mane Wearable Art, NFTCliques, FindCliques, Kamora360, ThriveCafe, XENthrive, The TAME Gallery, and ThriveFoundry.
The operating copy represented one connected ecosystem without ten logins, while the FAQ stated that full single-login support was not yet achieved and that the ecosystem was in Phase 0.

The AdLuxe Accelerator, Pro Growth, and Elite cards described discounts while displaying effective-spend amounts greater than their stated pre-discount budgets: 1600 to 1760, 3200 to 3840, and 8000 to 10000 USD respectively.

Rendered plan links used route keys that did not match their visible card names, including ThriveLaunch to plan=Loc and CHLOM Personal to plan=ThriveApps. The unauthenticated destinations redirected to login, so downstream entitlement was not tested.
The footer labels for the support-ticket dashboard and contact email resolved to the page fragment placeholder rather than a support or mail destination.

For every offer, verify visible card to selected SKU/plan, price, currency, interval, success/cancel route, signed webhook, and entitlement result in a controlled non-customer test.
Correct or explicitly redefine the discount language and independently recalculate every displayed budget, spend, percentage, and interval.
Verify the rendered ticket and email destinations from an anonymous session and from the authenticated support path.

inventory_only_surfaces.observation: A public login surface was reachable; authenticated portal behavior was not tested.
A public CrownThrive Impact Institute surface was reachable; program outcomes were not certified by this observation.
A public media surface was reachable; playback, entitlement, device, resolution, and monetization claims were not certified by this observation.
The root redirected to /guest; sacred-history, content, entitlement, and publishing state were not certified by this observation.
A public storefront was reachable; product, inventory, payment, fulfillment, tax, refund, rights, and entitlement state were not tested.

major_release_readback_requirements.required_evidence: Exact source commit, version or tag, builder/workflow identity, artifact SHA-256 values, environment, release timestamp, release disposition, rollback target, and immutable receipt.
Stable surface IDs; active, candidate, held, renamed, archived, successor, and retained-legal-scope states; old-to-new redirects; and checked-at timestamps.
A per-surface matrix distinguishing currently proven, bounded, held, historical, planned, and unavailable capabilities. Component phase must remain distinct from CrownThrive OS phase.
DNS, TLS, HTTP, rendered-route, dependency, health, and signed or independently reproducible heartbeat readback for every release-critical domain.

Visible CTA to exact provider product/price and internal SKU; amount, currency, interval, tax/refund posture, checkout success/cancel routes, signed webhook, fulfillment, and entitlement readback. Private provider IDs remain in protected evidence; the public receipt stays sanitized.
Canonical PentaDocs route, page-profile hash, source commit, rendered provider readback, support escalation path, and a statement that documentation state does not certify product/runtime state.
Active service roster only, current health, incident record for every material outage, recovery time, incident history, maintenance record, and archived-service suppression from current aggregation.
Definition, population, source, as-of date, accountable owner, qualification, expiration or refresh rule, and consent or rights evidence where a testimonial or identity is used.

Anonymous and applicable authenticated tests for CrownThrive to PentaDocs, CrownThrive to checkout and entitlement, Virality Music to CHLOM, Locticians to status and roadmap, and support to portal and ticket escalation.
Predeclared rollback target and triggers, rollback rehearsal where material, exact post-release page and provider readback, monitoring window, and preserved before/after evidence.

closure_rule: The public-surface gate may move from HOLD only when the exact release candidate has independent readback for every applicable critical requirement and CT-PUB-001 through CT-PUB-012 are closed, explicitly accepted by authorized owners, or scoped out with evidence. Repository validation alone cannot close this gate.
known_limits: No authenticated account, checkout, payment, webhook, entitlement, license, support-ticket, or provider-admin operation was performed.
Dynamic surfaces were inspected as rendered public pages; this record does not include provider configuration or private telemetry.
A negative text or link search is bounded to the rendered/public content observed on the access date and is not proof that content never exists elsewhere.
Public legal roster reconciliation must preserve historical and retained-data applicability; archived names cannot be removed solely to make marketing rosters match.
